llm_response.reason: The website coraliesom.shop claims to sell Floris van Bommel branded shoes under an unrelated store name, yet provides no company profile, business contact info, or verified legitimacy. There are no genuine external reviews or references to the site, which is suspicious for a retailer of a well-known brand. All customer assurances are generic and copy-pasted. The site also lacks transparent pricing and independent testimonials. These features strongly fit key fake online shop scam patterns: spoofing legitimate brands, absence of real-world company details, ambiguous privacy assurances, and no verifiable positive online reputation.
